edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is even before his root combo is fully online — trade Q-W-Q only when Nevermove is on cooldown.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: Level 3 is yours: Rune Prison out-roots his slow Nevermove windup — root him first and answer with Q-E flux.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: At 4-5 his E-into-Vision of Empire combo comes online for chunks and gank setup — Tear-farm and sidestep the root.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Even at 6: his drain sustain offsets your burst if he lands E. Fight only when Nevermove is down; never get pulled in.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: First mana item: he is immobile with a telegraphed root — Q spam plus Rune Prison dictates every trade before he ramps.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Late you outscale cleanly: ranged Q-E spread kites the drain-tank and Rune Prison locks him out — he never reaches you.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Demonic Ascension: flat 120s drain mode — disengage and reset when it starts; his E cools faster during it. - Nevermove: 12s at rank 1, his whole combo starter — fights begin when it is down. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip never gets it.

edits.before: His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Every 1000-range Q is a free deposit — Tear stacks fund the two-item spike, so cast whenever it costs you nothing.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: When Nevermove whiffs he has no combo starter for 12s — step in, land E-Q flux, and back out before it comes around.

edits.before: That is Swain’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Extended rotations feed his passive souls and drain — his whole kit wants long fights.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.
edits.after: His 750-range Q triple-hits up close — your 1000-range Q takes the same minion for free.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: Your W is the counter-root that beats his slow Nevermove windup — spend it poking and his next E starts the pull combo.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the same plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.
